description: An Instagram account's newest DM conversations, read live from Instagram (nothing is stored): who, their last message, and whether a reply can go now (Instagram allows one only within 24 hours of the person's last message, and only to people who wrote first). Reading is slow on purpose (Instagram allows about 2 reads a second), so ask for few. Open one with dm_thread_get; draft a reply with dm_reply_draft.

account_id.description: Instagram account whose conversations to list (a UUID): from accounts_list

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: dm_threads_list
title: DM conversations
